Adriana welcomes enquiries from researchers, research groups, institutions and R&D teams whose questions connect with her work on aging, early cognitive decline, visual attention and brain networks. Students and early-career researchers interested in these topics are also welcome to write.

## Areas for collaboration {#areas}

::: {.rr-grid .rr-grid-2}
::: {.rr-card .rr-card-quiet}
### Scientific collaboration

Joint studies and proposals on cognitive aging, subjective cognitive decline, mild cognitive impairment and dementia risk. See [research](research.qmd).
:::

::: {.rr-card .rr-card-quiet}
### Methods and analysis

Theory-based assessment of visual attention, resting-state and diffusion MRI, longitudinal and intervention analyses. See [methods and expertise](expertise.qmd).
:::

::: {.rr-card .rr-card-quiet}
### Clinical and applied research

Cognitive and imaging outcomes for neurological populations and for training or lifestyle interventions. See [where the expertise applies](expertise.qmd#applications).
:::

::: {.rr-card .rr-card-quiet}
### Data and open science

Shared data, scripts and workflows, and machine learning on health and social data. See [open science](expertise.qmd#open-science).
:::
:::
